# References {#references -}

Every work cited anywhere in the book, in one alphabetical list. It is generated
from `references.bib` at build time, so it contains exactly what is cited — no
more, no less. Entries that sit in the `.bib` file unused never appear here.

Recommended reading is a separate thing and lives on the
[Resources](resources.html#resources) page: annotated, ordered like the book,
and chosen rather than accumulated.

<!-- The bibliography is placed here. Without this div, pandoc appends it to
     the end of the whole book, which under `split_by: section` means it lands
     on whichever page happens to come last. -->
